# Uninstall-key corpus

100 original, public-product-shape registrations: 24 independently classified games, 60 applications, eight hidden/update/component records and eight launcher-owned aliases. These are authored from public product names and the Microsoft ARP field schema; no registry was exported from any computer. All user paths, sizes, dates and contents are generated. Engine marker contents are placeholders; they exercise representative layouts rather than claiming to reproduce proprietary installations. HKLM/HKCU and both registry views are represented (HKCU32 uses the explicit Wow6432Node path in the snapshot).

`records.json` is the reviewable labelled inventory. The three registry JSON descriptions generate Windows Registry Editor 5.00 files through the original `windows_registry.py` writer. Portal 2 has a separate synthetic Steam manifest so its uninstall alias must enrich the Steam group; absent-owner aliases must disappear.

No code copied from Playnite or any other implementation. Format references are recorded in records.json.
